svg.title: Spice frontend gate burndown — 2026-11-01
svg.desc: Syntax 920 of 920 valid decks accepted. Resources 834 resolved and 86 refused. Among the same 834 decks, deferred references decrease from 15791 to 6. Binding and simulation have separate denominators.

g.text: 2026-11-01 · Windows CPU · separate stages, separate denominators
86 refused: explicit limits/errors; no numerical pass implied
Expansion changes reference counts: 19,335 → 19,971. Binding is not simulation readiness.
No whole-corpus numerical, model/AC/transient bridge, Linux, GPU or production qualification.
